title: Storm Door Replacement — Before & After
summary: Replacement of an existing storm door with a new unit. See the before-and-after photos from this residential door replacement project.
description:
This project involved replacing an existing residential storm door with a new unit. The old storm door was removed and a replacement was installed at the home's entrance. The before-and-after photos document the change from the original door to the newly installed one.

Storm doors provide an additional layer at an exterior entrance. Replacing an older unit can improve the entrance's appearance and everyday usability.

Vitalii Handyman provides door repair, adjustments, hardware replacement, and selected handyman services throughout the Tampa Bay area. Contact us to discuss your door project and request an estimate.

Large-screen TVs require careful planning for placement and secure mounting. Wall mounting can help create a clean, organized entertainment area while making better use of the available space.
